# KayKit Playing Cards

The 52 standard playing cards and their face and shared back textures are from
KayKit Board Game Bits 1.0 EXTRA, created by Kay Lousberg / KayKit. The models
use the package’s Unity FBX exports. This is the complete deck used by Hearts;
jokers, blank cards, and alternate textures are excluded.

Source: https://kaylousberg.itch.io/board-game-bits
